rules.when: General coding and implementation work when no more specific design, review, or difficult-implementation rule applies, provided Claude Sonnet is available.
rules.why: The captain's primary general coding worker is Claude Sonnet. Use the Luna backup only when Sonnet is concretely unavailable, not as an equal quota-ranked alternative.

rules.when: General coding or otherwise default-routed work when Claude Sonnet is concretely unavailable and no more specific task rule applies.
rules.why: The captain's backup for the general coding worker and default route is Luna at xhigh effort.

rules.when: The task produces a critical design or architecture plan and the work is on the most critical path or is materially ambiguous.
rules.why: This rule supplies Astra and Fable at high effort as candidates for quota-informed selection for the most critical-path or materially ambiguous design and architecture work; it does not impose fallback-only ordering.

rules.when: The task produces a critical design or architecture plan, unless the more specific most-critical-path or materially-ambiguous rule applies.
rules.why: The captain's default for critical design and architecture plans is Astra or Fable at high effort.

rules.when: The task produces a critical design or architecture plan, unless the more specific most-critical-path or materially-ambiguous rule applies.
rules.why: The captain's default for critical design and architecture plans is Fable at high effort.

rules.when: Reviewing open pull requests, auditing existing changes, or checking PRs for defects without implementing fixes.
rules.why: Use a dedicated Luna worker at xhigh for bounded PR review and audit work so the captain session can remain responsive.

rules.when: New feature design or architecture work, including selecting an approach before implementation.
rules.why: Use Claude Code with Fable for design and architecture decisions.

rules.when: Ambiguous, high-risk, or difficult implementation work, or implementation that Luna could not complete.
rules.why: This rule supplies Fable, Astra, Opus 5, and Sol at high effort as candidates for quota-informed selection for ambiguous, high-risk, or difficult implementation work.
